rationale: Removed heap allocations, replaced exponentiation with fast pixel math, and implemented zero-copy worker transfers.
Added bank-grade 256-bit AES-GCM file encryption and PBKDF2 key derivation with 100,000 iterations and ENC1 binary header.
Added verified performance banner on task completion, 1-click speed receipt sharing, and voluntary support hub without paywalls.
Added 19 Category Pillar Hubs, bidirectional topic cluster mesh, 45-word AEO direct answer blocks, inline SVG flowcharts, and Schema.org semantic entities.

Implemented pure in-browser animated GIF89a encoder with LZW bit compression, 256-color deterministic palette quantization, synthetic and video frame sampling, and added turnkey wrangler deploy script.

Owner decision (docs/DECISION_LOG.md): removed all astrology tools; added birthday numerology (life path, birth, personal year) as arithmetic only; health calculators show formula results without advice and water intake removed; removed fake media ops, plan-only exact-KB compressor, transcriber and upscaler; audio trimmer made WAV-only; in-app privacy wording aligned with the server visit log.

Owner asked that only real tools ship. The sitemap now lists a guide only when its destination route really runs the ?tool= operation (lib/seo/live-tools.ts, derived from the OPERATIONS arrays and the PDF page tool and image editor controls). Placeholder pages (/video/compress, /image/ocr, /developer/sql-visualizer), /roadmap and category hubs without a live tool are left out; build-time lastModified is removed. 76 catalog entries linked real tools on the wrong workbench, which silently opened a different tool; they now point at the route that runs them.

Task A1: Refactored smart dropzone actions into components/smart-dropzone-actions.ts, removed placeholder links (/developer/sql-visualizer, compress-pdf, split-pdf), repointed tools to working workbench routes (/developer/advanced, /web/workbench, /creator/workbench), and added test verifying 100% of dropzone actions pass isLiveToolUrl.

Task A2: Removed offline-ready claim from trust ribbon in components/app-shell.tsx, aligned guarantees to match DECISION_LOG.md §6 ('Your Files & Inputs Never Touch a Server', 'No Third-Party Trackers', 'No Client-Side Analytics'), and removed unverified hardcoded count from blog title.

Task A3: Verified all internal tool links in blog posts and templates pass isLiveToolUrl; repointed markdown-to-pdf to /text/writing, social media post formatter to /creator/workbench, legal NDA to /documents/workbench; replaced placeholder video compressor post with live in-browser Image Compressor & Converter (/image/optimize); removed unverifiable claims (sub-second, 0 bytes uploaded, zero network egress, completely offline, zero cloud egress); and added automated vitest scanning for links and forbidden claim patterns.

Task A4: Stripped city, region, and raw referer URL from edge proxy visit logger in proxy.ts; retained only coarse metadata (country, device, referer_source category, path, tool, lang, time); updated .github/SECURITY.md to accurately document logged fields.
